rows.grounds: sandhi form of dvi-bhāgaḥ; indicates division into two parts
compound denoting the breadth or extent of the house
locative adverb indicating the front position
architectural term for surrounding space or circuit
adverb indicating placement on a single side

items.question: What proportional division of house width and enclosure space applies in the daṇḍaka arrangement?
premises: The house width is specified as two parts.
The enclosure space is located in front.
A further specification places the enclosure space on one side.
items.inference: The daṇḍaka arrangement assigns a two-part house width with the enclosure space positioned in front and on one side.
uncertainties: The exact proportional allocation of vāraḥ relative to the two parts is not fully explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: The house width is two parts; in front is the enclosure space, and then on one side as well.
